purpose: Activate only the production classes accepted by M3, add exact value-invariant committee support to the existing Graham personnel overlay, preserve exact internal fair arithmetic, and keep unresolved intervals and nonzero opponent-specific matchup increments fail closed.

EXACT_ONE_FOR_ONE.rule: M4 does not create a second one-for-one arithmetic path. The existing governed personnel production engine remains authoritative. Never reapply an already-present healthy-minus-replacement loss.

requirements: at least two included committee members
every included committee member has a calibrated locked Walters value
all included committee members have the identical locked Walters value
baseline contributors are explicitly excluded from replacement credit when applicable
exact team loss is reproducible without workload-share assumptions
opponent-specific matchup increment is exactly zero under the current M4 scope
VALUE_INVARIANT_COMMITTEE.formula: effectiveReplacementValue = common locked Walters value; teamContributionDelta = effectiveReplacementValue - healthyValue

ZERO_MATCHUP_REVIEW.rule: A completed opponent-specific football review may validly resolve to zero additional matchup points. Zero is recorded as a reviewed decision, not treated as missing analysis.

unifiedPersonnelLedger.rule: Accepted M4 committee events are written into the active week personnel ledger currentCases map as NUMERIC_ELIGIBLE exact events so future base-personnel recomputations retain the committee effect.

recomputePolicy.rule: After an accepted committee event, recompute the affected game's entire personnel overlay from current numeric-eligible personnel cases rather than stacking a new delta onto the existing overlay.

doubleCountGuards: Do not reapply a one-for-one loss already present on the live board.
Do not credit a baseline starter's full value again as committee replacement value without distinct incremental role evidence.
Do not apply receiver or defensive-line cluster treatment twice.
Do not combine a separate unavailable player into another case without its own governed personnel event.
Do not use opponent-specific narrative to resolve an otherwise unresolved replacement interval.
Do not carry temporary personnel or matchup overlays into the team power rating.

staging.taskRule: Research tasks may stage only current football evidence that independently satisfies an accepted M4 class. Repository code owns locked-value lookup, exact arithmetic, double-count checks, ledger mutation and live Graham recomputation.

m5Policy: M4 activation itself must not copy any M2 shadow number into the live board. M5 must re-evaluate the active week from current football evidence and stage only currently valid accepted cases.
